params.prompt: Instantly understandable mobile app ad visual, square 1:1, premium glossy 3D render. COMPOSITION: the hero group is placed in the LOWER-CENTER, occupying only from 38% to 86% of the height and the middle 70% of the width; the upper 34% must stay free of objects (only background atmosphere) for a headline; bottom 12% free. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no money, no coins. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). Scene: a large glossy smartphone standing upright showing a clean white app list screen with four rows (icons: hospital cross, pink ribbon, red heart, bandage) with green check circles, except one row with an empty red dashed circle glowing; a red notification badge with an exclamation mark symbol on the phone corner. Meri stands beside the phone pointing at the empty row with a wink. BACKGROUND: luminous gradient from bright sky blue to soft lilac with soft light rays, floating translucent frosted-glass circles and plus shapes at various depths, gentle bokeh.
